name: Dragonmaw Retreat
_map: Turtle instance map 816 (5-player dungeon, level 25+). Entrances: Wetlands (Grim Batol, trigger 5343) and Grim Reaches (trigger 5346). Map 816 is unused in 3.3.5.

instance._areatriggers: 5343 front entrance (Wetlands), 5346 back entrance (Grim Reaches), 5344/5345 the exits inside.
instance._graveyard: Turtle has no graveyard for the instance: the Wetlands Crossroads graveyard (WorldSafeLocs 7, the nearest one), {map,x,y,z,o}.

_extra_quests: The Redbrand Lie (41754: the Redbrand Tablet in the dungeon -> Curator Thorius, Ironforge; 41755: Thorius -> Torwyn Redbrand, Ironforge) and Pedestal of Unity (41774, the pedestal in the dungeon).
_exclude_quests: The Redbrand Archive (40605): Torwyn Redbrand's other quest, given in the Badlands (Turtle content of another zone).
